name: AirportSearch

parameters.help_en:
The airport type. Valid values:

- 0: domestic airports.
- 2: domestic airports and nearby airports.
- 3: international airports
parameters.help_zh: 0国内机场，2国内机场+临近机场，3国际机场
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The header parameter obtained from the enterprise access credential operation. Add this parameter to the header. In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数 由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token
